# lidhold

> lidhold keeps a Mac awake with the lid closed for exactly as long as a task runs, a coding agent or any command, and lets it sleep when it is done. macOS 14 or newer, Apple Silicon. Command-line tool with a small root helper and a per-user daemon.

## What problem it solves

Closing a MacBook's lid is an explicit sleep request that user-level tools such as `caffeinate` cannot override. Long-running coding agents (Claude Code and similar) get suspended mid-task. `pmset disablesleep 1` does override the lid but nothing turns it back off, so the machine can drain or overheat in a bag. lidhold applies that override only while an agent is active, through leases with a TTL, and reverts it automatically: a root helper undoes the override after 90 seconds without a heartbeat, and battery and thermal guards release it early.

## How agents use it

Supported agents: Claude Code and Cursor. Connect once with `lidhold hooks install claude-code` or `lidhold hooks install cursor` (`lidhold setup` does this for every agent it detects), then restart open sessions. Nothing per session after that. Cursor support covers both the cursor-agent CLI and the IDE agent via ~/.cursor/hooks.json.

Claude Code hooks call `lidhold hook claude-code` on session start, each tool call, stop, and session end. Each event refreshes, shortens, or drops a lease for that session. Any other tool can do the same with `lidhold lease take <name> --ttl 30m` and `lidhold lease release <name>`.

## Any command

    lidhold run -- cargo test

Holds for exactly the command's lifetime: lease taken before it starts, refreshed while it runs, released on exit. Exit code passes through, Ctrl-C reaches the command.

## Install

    brew install aanjaneykumarverma/tap/lidhold
    lidhold setup

`lidhold setup` installs the privileged helper (one sudo prompt), starts the per-user daemon, installs Claude Code hooks if Claude Code is present, and runs `lidhold doctor`.

## Commands

- `lidhold on --for 2h`, `lidhold off`, `lidhold status`, `lidhold doctor`
- `lidhold lease take|release|list`
- `lidhold hooks install|remove|status claude-code`
- `lidhold config init|show` (guard thresholds: battery floor 20%, thermal ceiling "heavy")
- `lidhold license activate|deactivate|status|verify`

## Pricing

Free: manual holds, status, doctor, and both guards. Paid: agent hooks, leases, and lidhold run, USD 19 one time, one person on up to 3 machines, 7-day trial without a key. No subscription. No telemetry.
